fields.description:
Collapse the mockup's two trailing sections. Admin and system fields move off the main page into the existing More Info tab so the record stops being a scroll.

=== FIELDS ===

* Section name: All Additional Information, inside the existing More Info tab

* Operator External ID — Text(80), External ID, case-insensitive. Marc created this Aug 13; replaces the old auto-number Operator_ID__c.

* Operator Alias — Long Text Area, semicolon-delimited (e.g. 'Catena; Catena Media; CatenaMedia')

* Operator Short Code — Text

* Currency — top-left of the section

* Brand Family — top-right of the section

* Created By / Last Modified By — standard fields, no build

* Logo URL — URL (see BUILD-145)

* Operator Name is NOT included — header only, decided 2026-08-17.

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* No new tab needed — the Operator page already had two tabs, Details and More Info. Kobi live: 'Actually, no, there's already a tab there. Never mind. We can just use the existing tab.'

* Owner is removed from this section and from the layout — 'they're not really going to use it... we'll get rid of the owner.'

* P&L Book Name is deliberately NOT created — Kobi: 'I don't remember that one. We'll leave that out. We'll let them come back to us.' Confirmation happens while demoing the pages, not as a separate ticket.

* CMS Last Sync is deliberately NOT created yet — Kobi asked, Taryn said 'Not yet', Kobi: 'that's okay. I don't think it's urgent.' It gets scoped with the CMS integration work, not here.

* Do not build the error/audit log view. Joyce asked for 'almost like an error log kind of view or audit log' but the population mechanism and ownership fall out of CMS scoping — picked up when CMS integration is scoped.

* Read-only convention per the Aug 17 call with Marc: anything the user shouldn't modify is read-only on the layout.

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===

* The 'squash' ambiguity. Taryn thinks Joyce said delete System Information outright (\~36:00 of the Aug 13 recording); Kobi thinks it applied only to Owner. Current build keeps the fields and moves them to More Info. Kobi's counter-argument on the call was sound — 'a logo URL, those are all important things for them to configure' — but it is still an assumption. Taryn to rewatch and confirm.

* Brand Family. Kobi didn't recognise it: 'What is— is brand family like something they wanted? I don't remember talking about it, but I guess it's fine.' Kept on faith. Confirm with Joyce or drop it.

* Which of these are CMS-written vs manual is still unresolved — Emily assumed CMS-driven, mechanism pending the Strah session. Building the fields is safe; deciding read-only vs editable is not.

=== NOTES ===

* ALREADY BUILT — confirmed on the Aug 17 Kobi/Taryn call. Ticket is retroactive documentation.

* Gotcha for the card: sections have to be dragged INSIDE the tab component or they render outside it — hit live on the call.

* Provenance: OP-7.

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc OP-7

* Aug 13 call — squash + tab

* Slack Marc Aug 13 23:33

* Aug 17 call — built live, P&L and CMS Sync excluded

Dependencies: BUILD-126

Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.
